exposure: prepregnancy BMI (low: < 20 kg/m2, normal: 20 to < 25 kg/m2, high: >= 25 kg/m2)
cohort: 426 pregnancies in women with type 1 diabetes mellitus, recruited before 20 weeks gestation.
finding: Low prepregnancy BMI was associated with preterm delivery, while high prepregnancy BMI was associated with emergent delivery for maternal indications.
gest_age: Outcomes defined by gestational age: spontaneous abortion (<20 weeks) and preterm delivery (<37 weeks).
